correctness.rationale: Exact incomplete-gamma parent tail expansion; logarithmic maximum-CDF expansion; global exponential-tail and derivative bounds give uniform approximations. Exact floor shift provides lattice term. At alpha=1 H_n=G_1 identically; for alpha<1 the binomial term dominates; alpha>1 lattice plus tail term dominates. All suprema are computed analytically and matched by gridpoint lower bounds. Numerical standalone checker passes 4 models with 3 sample sizes each, but is explicitly noncertifying.

value.rationale: A naturally motivated complete shape classification for accuracy of a Fréchet approximation under integer-recorded heavy-tailed observations. It supplies exact nonzero rate constants, separates two physical error mechanisms (sampling versus rounding), and reveals a critical exact cancellation at shape one, rather than merely repeating a distribution definition, finite computation or general first-order extreme-value theorem.
